title: Rights-aware offline lessons and pending-attempt reconciliation
baseCommit: c63965ba (KAN-154 BUILD-09 head; Build chain KAN-75..82, 154)
whatBuilt: Server-authored, rights-approved offline packs bound to exact immutable source/criteria/renderer versions, SHA-256 integrity + bounded per-owner storage quota
Rights/eligibility refusals deny (unknown pack, unconsented, source withdrawn, lease expired, storage limit) - never a forged success

Pending answers preserve original base version + explicit command identity; on reconnect the SERVER re-authorizes (session eligibility, consent, source withdrawal, lease) then reassesses with the PROTECTED criteria key
No local pass flag: a client pass claim is carried as a claim only and overruled by the server verdict; honest revocation-limitation disclosure for already-downloaded bytes
Duplicate command ids converge to the recorded outcome; out-of-order replays ordered by staging time; committed evidence survives expiry/withdrawal
Account-switched users leak nothing (downloads/pending are owner-scoped, not_owner); AI generation stays online (no on-device model qualified)

provenEndToEnd.rightsDownload: eligible owner gets immutable digest + bounded size; unconsented/unknown refusals deny
provenEndToEnd.boundedStorage: per-owner quota enforced across downloads (over-limit denied storage_limit)
provenEndToEnd.pendingReplay: pending attempts bound to original base replayed in order and server-assessed on reconnect
provenEndToEnd.noLocalPassFlag: client pass claim never flips the server verdict (wrong claim -> needs_review, 0 points)
provenEndToEnd.duplicateOutOfOrder: replay of a command id converges (duplicate, same recorded outcome)
provenEndToEnd.leaseExpiryWithdrawal: new offline commands denied (acceptEvidence=false) with committed evidence preserved and revocation limitation disclosed
provenEndToEnd.accountSwitchWrongUser: another account cannot read downloads, stage, or reconcile (not_owner) - nothing leaks

verification.offlinelearningCheck: npm run offlinelearning:check -> 7/7 tests pass (compile tsconfig.offlinelearning.json + node --test)

status: Testing (submit candidate; D-095 separate reviewer + exact reviewed SHA required before Done)
notes: Native prerequisites per ticket: KAN-58, KAN-40, KAN-62, KAN-68, KAN-140 (all in Testing); this module composes pack integrity + consent + source-lifecycle + attempt-persistence + sync seams as server contracts. Offline SYNTHETIC tests alone cannot close hosted/provider/educational outcomes; no hosted/provider/load/privacy/commercial gate is claimed closed by this work.
